name: FND_RRA_ODRS_
description: This table will store order details

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: Primary key field for orders

columns.name: ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: User key field for orders

columns.name: ORDER_DATE
columns.description: Date the order was placed

columns.name: CHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Date the order was changed. Same as order date to start with.

columns.name: SUBMIT_DATE
columns.description: Date the order was submitted for processing

columns.name: SHIP_DATE
columns.description: Date the order was shipped

columns.name: DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Date the order was delivered

columns.name: SHIPPING_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Shipping method identifier referenced from FND_RRA_SHIPPING_METHODS

columns.name: SHIPPING_COST
columns.description: Cost for shipping based on chosen shipping method

columns.name: ESTIMATED_DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Estimated date the order will be delivered

columns.name: BASKET_FLAG
columns.description: Determines if this is a basket record. There can be only 1 record for a user with value = 'Y'. When a user start adding items to a basket, a record is created in orders table with basket_flag = 'Y' and once user submits the order, the value changes to 'N' and order gets assigned a appropriate status value

columns.name: ORDER_STATUS
columns.description: Values could be 'DRAFT', 'PROCESSING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED'

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Reference to the customer creating the order

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Unique identifier for the currency (Can reference FND_CURRENCIES.currency_code)

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount for the order as the sum of items ordered and shipping cost

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate used to convert from base currency to user preferred currecy

columns.name: SHIP_TO_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Reference to customer addresses for the customer

columns.name: BILL_TO_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Reference to customer addresses for the customer

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Descriptive comments for the order

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
